comments.text: This border lies between Tibet and Nepal. Tibet has suffered numerous tragedies since the Chinese invasion and illegal occupation. The recent flood tragedy began in Tibet, where no journalists or even ordinary people are allowed to enter. China is spreading a different story about its origin and sources, and we suspect it might be due to a large dam China built across occupied Tibet.
